`# The lending policy allows each member to hold five books at once.`

All 16 tests now pass. I changed these files in `catalog/`:
- `members.py`: `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5, matching the comment on line 3.
- `search.py`: it now imports `normalize` from `catalog.text`. It was importing from `catalog.nonexistent`, which doesn't exist.
- `books.py`: `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`.
- `fees.py`: `late_fee` now multiplies days by `DAILY_FEE`. It was adding them.
- `inventory.py`: `recent(n)` now returns the last `n` events. It was returning `n + 1`.
- `factory.py`: `sample_books()` now includes the `Emma` book it was missing.
